disambiguator: Resolving which skill fits a task -> this. Remembering facts across sessions -> cavemem/strategic-memory. Doing the task itself (code, design, docs) -> that domain skill, not the router.
do_not_use_when: Writing code, designing UI, or editing docs directly
purpose: Route a task to the right skill: pick which specialized skill fits the user's request.
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
use_when: Route this task to the right skill
